controls.name: driveDb
controls.doc: The gain before the clip, dB. 0 is no push: a signal under the ceiling goes through bit for bit.

controls.name: ceilingDb
controls.doc: The ceiling, dBFS: no sample leaves above it.

controls.name: softnessPct
controls.doc: How far under the ceiling the bend starts, percent of CLIPPER_KNEE_SPAN of the ceiling. 0 is a hard clip. Above the knee a sample bends along a hyperbola that leaves the straight line at slope 1 and never reaches the ceiling.

readouts.name: gainReductionDb
readouts.doc: The most the clip took off the block's loudest sample, in dB with CLAP's sign: 0 while nothing reached the knee, negative the reduction, measured after the drive.

CLIPPER_KNEE_SPAN.doc: The share of the ceiling the bend spans at a softness of 100 %: the knee sits at (1 - span x softness) x ceiling, half the ceiling at full softness, 6 dB under it.
